primitives.name: Equipment Weight Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: EQUIPMENT All clothing and equipment should not weigh over eight pounds when dry.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W_{eq}': 'weight of equipment in kilograms', 'W_{max}': 'maximum allowable weight in kilograms'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear relationship between equipment mass and injury probability; uniform distribution of mass across body segments.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When W_eq > W_max, risk of musculoskeletal strain increases exponentially.

layer2.mapping: GSI probabilistic model uses W_eq as input variable to compute injury likelihood; GSE employs it for dynamic load balancing during scrimmage.
layer2.telemetry: Measured via scale calibration and wearable inertial sensors.

primitives.name: Shoulder Pad Coverage
primitives.verbatim_quote: Shoulder pads should cover the collar bone and be sprung over the point of the shoulder.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{sh}': 'coverage area of shoulder pad in square centimeters', 'L_{collar}': 'length of collarbone in centimeters'}
primitives.assumptions: Pad geometry conforms to anatomical structure; spring mechanism reduces impact force.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If C_sh < L_collar, insufficient protection leads to increased fracture risk.

layer2.mapping: GSI maps C_sh to collision energy absorption efficiency; GSE simulates contact dynamics using spring-damper models.
layer2.telemetry: Computed from CAD models and validated via impact testing.

primitives.name: Hip Joint Protection
primitives.verbatim_quote: The point and edge of each hip joint and the small of the back should be covered with a light felt pad about one half inch thick.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{hip}': 'protective thickness of pad in millimeters', 'F_{impact}': 'impact force in newtons', 'A_{contact}': 'contact area in square meters'}
primitives.assumptions: Pad thickness inversely correlates with peak stress; contact area remains constant.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_hip < 1.27 mm, risk of internal organ damage rises significantly.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes F_impact reduction based on P_hip; GSE integrates this into kinematic simulation for posture correction.
layer2.telemetry: Monitored via pressure sensors embedded in padding material.
